recurrent prediction equivalence after inference-only load

invalid belief supervision masks
singleton minibatch finite parameters
configuration rejection

second_static_review_verification.state_source: Synthetic native-state and transport-failure fixtures; no native battle comparison.
checks: reset failures and first playable boundary rejection
truncated handshake and interrupted request resource cleanup
generation and tick progress validation, including short terminal steps
batch receipt count, kind, owner and action order
incomplete receipt groups and partial resets rejected
fixed baseline and historical snapshot identity on resume
v2 dataset shapes, finite values, episode order and future label consistency
replay records real start and terminal tick

third_static_review_verification.state_source: Synthetic native-state and transport-failure fixtures; no native battle comparison.
checks: offline evaluation preserves original initial-policy identity and rejects missing baselines
training rejects existing run artifacts before modifying them
interrupted held-out evaluations are archived and rerun without retraining completed models
completed or unknown evaluation records are not automatically replaced
held-out winner, result, checkpoint round, counts and finite metrics are validated
formal plans require from-scratch training and complete fresh interaction budgets
integer configuration rejects silent truncation and booleans
direct evaluation rejects invalid schedule counts
third_static_review_verification.native_runtime: Not exercised in this review; no strategy or throughput claims.

fourth_static_review_verification.state_source: Synthetic native-state and fault fixtures; no native battle comparison.
checks: last sampling step interrupted before PPO update does not produce resumable state
callback cancellation at the exact budget cannot mark an unfinished update complete
resume manifest is published after all required state files are saved
resume config, RNG and league manifest identity checked before state mutation
future labels retain the last observed nonterminal successor without crossing episode boundaries
invalid label inputs clear pending buffer targets
collection rejects incompatible label schemas before publishing datasets
auxiliary scoring rejects non-finite, missing or incorrectly shaped predictions
offline next-card targets use the same normalization as training
fourth_static_review_verification.native_runtime: Not exercised in this review; no strategy or throughput claims.
fourth_static_review_verification.compatibility: Network dimensions unchanged; legacy resume states remain readable but lack v2 state-file identity checks.

fifth_static_review_verification.state_source: Synthetic native-state and fault fixtures; no native battle comparison.
checks: cancelled rollouts do not publish unupdated self-play snapshots or fixed evaluations
cancelled rollouts do not emit completed training metrics; summaries count confirmed updates
v4 singleton final and size-one minibatches retain finite parameters
shared PPO update matches upstream RecurrentPPO parameters exactly for regular v4 batches
snapshot registration rejects category aliases, path-like IDs and changed identities
retired IDs still in use cannot be reassigned to new historical weights
resume rejects duplicate or reserved snapshot identities before mutating the pool
fifth_static_review_verification.native_runtime: Not exercised in this review; no strategy or throughput claims.
fifth_static_review_verification.compatibility: Network dimensions and resume schema unchanged; malformed snapshot identities are rejected.

sixth_static_review_verification.state_source: Synthetic native-state and fault fixtures; no native battle comparison.
checks: incremental public elixir matches full history including duplicate ticks, saturation and phase boundaries
historical elixir queries preserve before-state temporal features
observation construction does not scan the complete public ledger
reset clears public-event indices; out-of-order events cannot corrupt the sorted index
learner and opponent actions reject fractional, nonfinite, boolean, string and overflowing encodings
invalid integer actions retain existing native-environment penalty handling
malformed opponent actions do not advance stored recurrent memory or episode-start flags
sixth_static_review_verification.native_runtime: Not exercised in this review; no strategy or measured throughput claims.
sixth_static_review_verification.compatibility: Network dimensions, observation schema and resume schema unchanged; lossy action conversion is rejected.

seventh_static_review_verification.state_source: Synthetic native-state and output-failure fixtures; no native battle comparison.
checks: offline evaluation identity receipt and chart exist before completion is committed
chart and identity output failures leave retryable failed evaluation status
checkpoint identity is pinned before loading and rechecked after loading and before completion
checkpoint replacement during inference is rejected rather than attributed to the replacement file
held-out reports reject failed, running, invalid or wrong-round completion markers
regenerated reports remove stale per-seed CSV when no valid rows remain
seventh_static_review_verification.native_runtime: Not exercised in this review; no strategy or measured throughput claims.
seventh_static_review_verification.compatibility: Network dimensions and resume schema unchanged; report aggregation requires valid committed evaluation status.
